title: The ALMA Discovery of the Rotating Disk and Fast Outflow of Cold Molecular Gas in NGC 1275
question: What are the morphology and kinematics of the cold molecular gas in the inner kpc to ~30 pc of NGC 1275, how is the AGN fed, what do the blue-shifted absorption features imply, and what is the SMBH mass from gas dynamics?

what.value: Inner filament total gas mass 1.8e9 Msun used for missing-flux estimate

evidence.quote: total gas mass of the inner filament of $1.8\times10^{9}~M_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$ (cite: Lim2008)
The resultant Bondi accretion rate was $7.4\times10^{-5}M_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$ yr$^{-1}$

what.value: Stellar velocity dispersion 250 km/s and M_BH 10^8.61 Msun giving SoI of 60 pc

evidence.quote: Using the stellar dispersion velocity of $250$ km s$^{-1}$ and $M_{\rm BH}$ of $10^{8.61}M_{\ensuremath{\odot}}$ (cite: Bettoni2003)

recipe.method: ALMA pipeline then gaincal gaintype=K residual delay correction and phase/amplitude self-cal on bright continuum
uvcontsub order 1 then tclean with natural and Briggs 0.5 weighting at 20 km/s
D_spec = I_BP/sigma_BP, sigma_T = I_T/D_spec propagated into spectra

recipe.goal: Derive H2 gas mass and accretion rates
recipe.method: Solomon & Vanden Bout CO luminosity to mass; accretion rate M/t_dyn and M/tau
assumptions: CO(2-1)/CO(1-0) = 1; alpha_CO = 4.8 (alternative 0.6-0.8); thin disk h=0.1r; v~25 km/s

recipe.goal: Absorption optical depth and column density
recipe.method: tau from 40 mJy absorption against 7 Jy continuum; LTE, covering factor 1, Tex 100 K, HCN/H2 = 1e-9
MGE fit to HST F814W image with TinyTim PSF, masking AGN and dust region, uniform M/L

recipe.goal: Fit gas disk kinematics for SMBH mass
recipe.method: KinMS models with circular velocity from MGE_circular_velocity, exponential disk; mpfit minimization then grid search over M_BH and inclination
key_parameters: fitting area 1.55x1.55 arcsec, 4687-5580 km/s, 129x129x47 pixels, natural-weighted cube
assumptions: axisymmetric potential, circular motion, exponential gas disk, uniform dispersion

answer_key.quantity: H2 gas mass of inner disk (alpha_CO=4.8)

evidence.quote: we obtain the H$_{2}$ column density of $2.3\times10^{22}$ cm$^{-2}$
we get $\dot{M}_{\rm gas}=1$-$2~M_{\odot}$ yr$^{-1}$ and $\dot{M}_{\rm gas}=10~M_{\odot}$ yr$^{-1}$, respectively

not_stated_but_needed: Image sizes, cell sizes, cleaning thresholds and masks for tclean
Self-calibration solution parameters and reference model
mpfit settings and grid spacing for the SMBH search
MGE fit parameters and Gaussian components
score_reason: Public data and a clear modelling approach, but imaging, self-cal and fitting details are partly unstated.
rediscovery_reason: Data are public, the processing and the modelling are largely described, and results (gas mass, M_BH) are numeric.
